decisions.reason: The assessment-date amendment explicitly concerns the page-one field; it does not necessarily change the footer's required information or presentation. The separate footer amendment is already represented.
Changing the page-one assessment-date field does not alter the distribution warning. The warning refinements in the same message are independent and already represented.
The assessment-date placeholder decision does not change the content, format, or detail level of the result explanation.
The assessment-date field amendment does not change how the vehicle group is presented.
Although both requirements apply to page one, the assessment-date amendment does not change the dashboard's score fields, prominence, heading, or result visibility.
The specific assessment-date field correction does not necessarily modify the report-wide visual design standard or retained design direction.
The source decision applies to the assessment-date field on page one and does not change the internal header used from page 2 onward.
The assessment-date amendment does not alter the required RR-01 footer code.
The assessment-date amendment does not alter the required RR-01 internal-header code.
The assessment-date amendment does not change the RR-01 report-detail identifier requirement.
The page-two copy corrections are independent amendments in the same message, not consequences of the page-one assessment-date decision, and are already represented.
The assessment-date field amendment does not change the scoring summary's presentation, fields, or purpose.
